Frontend E2E (change-password, setup-recovery, forgot-password flow, expenses CRUD, purchases w/ stock sync, accounts dashboard, sidebar 10 nav items) all PASS. Admin password restored to 'swarna123'.

issues: React a11y warning: DialogContent missing Description or aria-describedby. Not user-visible but should add <DialogDescription /> for accessibility.

Backend: TestPurchases (product-linked purchase increments stock and updates purchase_price, delete reverses stock, freetext purchase leaves stock unchanged, 404 on missing)
Backend: TestReports (/reports/summary shape incl. profit, cash_flow, expenses.by_category, daily; /reports/daily)
Backend: TestRegression (shop-info, dashboard/stats, bill creation decrements stock)

Frontend: Purchases - select existing product from dropdown, add purchase, list shows it; delete works
Frontend: Accounts - net_profit/net_cash values render, all 8 metric cards visible (revenue/cogs/gross/expenses/cashin/cashout/purchases/credit), Today & This Month quick buttons switch range

action_items: (Optional/low) Add <DialogDescription> inside Dialog components (e.g., Forgot Password) to silence Radix a11y console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 858 lines - approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (auth.py, products.py, bills.py, purchases_expenses.py, reports.py) for maintainability.

get_expenses / get_purchases / get_summary filter dates in Python after fetching up to 5000 docs from Mongo. Once dataset grows this becomes O(N); use Mongo $gte/$lte on the 'date' field (ISO strings compare correctly) as already done in get_bills.

Purchases API updates product's purchase_price on every purchase - fine, but no history of old cost. COGS uses current cost only, so back-dated reports will be slightly inaccurate. Consider storing cost snapshot on the BillItem.
reports/summary loads full collections into memory each call (bills, purchases, expenses, payments, products up to 5000 each). Add Mongo aggregation pipeline once data volume grows.
CORS: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' fallback is disallowed by browsers. Not observed to break in this test but should be tightened via env CORS_ORIGINS.
No auth guard on expense/purchase/report endpoints (username/password login is client-side only). Acceptable for the internal single-shop use-case but worth noting.
test_credentials: admin / swarna123 (RESTORED at end of run). Security answer: 'Gangaram' (case-insensitive).
seed_data_creation: Tests self-clean: temp_category + temp_product fixtures delete themselves; temp expenses/purchases created via UI were deleted; passwords/recovery reverted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_swarna_backend.py is idempotent and safe to re-run against cloud URL. It temporarily changes admin password twice but reverts to swarna123. Set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL if not in env.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. All Phase 1-4 features work end-to-end. Purchases correctly increments stock (verified: Test Urea qty went up by 3 after UI-driven purchase then reverted on delete). Accounts dashboard shows Net Profit ₹157, Net Cash ₹6,242 for the current period which correctly reflects test data.
